description:
This is a Pre-Solicitation notice for a one-time off base repair and certification of one JetCal Tester. FOB destinations is
Tinker AFB OK.


No quotes can be accepted until the solicitation has been posted.


Please make sure all provisions and clauses are appropriately filled in (where applicable), when submitting a quote in.
Please send in the actual solicitation completed along with any other documentation to support your comopany's quote.
Please make sure information stated is readable and legible. This is a Firm Fixed Price procurement, so please state the
price on your quote as all inclusive of everything. (i.e. shipping, taxes, fees, etc.)
